ssheArchitectures.name: Concentric Triple-Tube Aseptic SSHE (15 kW Mutator, 300 RPM, PEEK Floating Blades, Chrome-Plated Nickel Cylinder)
ssheArchitectures.classification: Aseptic UHT / HTST Continuous Scraped-Surface Heat Exchanger (3-A Sanitary 31-07 & FDA 21 CFR § 113)
ssheArchitectures.cylinderLinerMaterial: Pure Nickel with Hard Chrome Plating (0.25 mm layer, 850 HV)
ssheArchitectures.bladeLoadingMechanism: Centrifugal Hydraulic Lift with Backpressure Compensated Pins
ssheArchitectures.jacketMedium: High-Pressure Saturated Steam (up to 150°C) or Glycol Brine (-15°C)
ssheArchitectures.asepticSealType: Dual Mechanical Cartridge Seal with Live Steam Condensate Barrier (1.2 bar)
ssheArchitectures.description: Heavy-duty continuous aseptic scraped-surface heat exchanger designed for viscous, particulate-laden, or fouling-prone fluids. Features high-velocity steam jackets, high-thermal-conductivity chrome-plated nickel cylinder wall, and floating PEEK scraper blades ensuring continuous boundary-layer renewal.

ssheArchitectures.name: Vertical Heavy-Viscosity SSHE (30 kW High-Torque Mutator, 200 RPM, Polyketone Blades, 316L Stainless Liner)
ssheArchitectures.classification: High-Viscosity & High-Fouling Heavy-Duty SSHE (ASME Section VIII & 3-A Sanitary)
ssheArchitectures.bladeLoadingMechanism: Heavy-Duty Spring-Loaded Blade Mounts (Constant 25 N/m Pre-Load)
ssheArchitectures.jacketMedium: Pressurized Hot Water Loop / Thermal Oil (up to 180°C)
ssheArchitectures.asepticSealType: Sterile Pressurized Water Flush Dual Mechanical Barrier Seal
ssheArchitectures.description: Vertical orientation scraped-surface heat exchanger engineered for high-viscosity pastes, tomato concentrates, and starch-thickened sauces. The vertical design eliminates gravitational deflection of the mutator shaft and enables complete drainability for aseptic sterilization.

ssheArchitectures.name: Pilot/Laboratory Cryogenic Crystallizer SSHE (5.5 kW, 500 RPM, Carbon-Filled PTFE Blades)
ssheArchitectures.classification: Sanitary Crystallization & Plasticizing Chiller SSHE (EHEDG Type EL Class I)
ssheArchitectures.cylinderLinerMaterial: Nickel Alloy (Hastelloy C-22) with Hard Wear Coating
ssheArchitectures.jacketMedium: Direct Expansion Liquid Ammonia (R-717) / CO2 Chilling (-30°C)
ssheArchitectures.asepticSealType: Single Aseptic Lip Seal with Nitrogen Barrier
ssheArchitectures.description: High-speed laboratory and pilot-scale scraped-surface heat exchanger optimized for rapid continuous crystallization, margarine and shortening plasticizing, and ice cream pre-freezing.

ssheArchitectures.name: Aging Degraded Production SSHE (Worn Mutator Bearings, Eccentric Rotor, Pitted Chrome Liner)
ssheArchitectures.classification: High-Risk Mechanically Degraded SSHE (Severe Blade Chattering, Chrome Peeling, Seal Steam Leakage)
ssheArchitectures.cylinderLinerMaterial: Worn Chrome-Plated Nickel (Delaminating Flakes, Pitted Grooves)
ssheArchitectures.bladeLoadingMechanism: Fatigued Springs & Worn Blade Pivot Slots
ssheArchitectures.jacketMedium: Saturated Steam with Unregulated Condensate Flooding
ssheArchitectures.asepticSealType: Depressurized Steam Barrier Seal (<0.2 bar steam pressure)
ssheArchitectures.description: Sub-optimally maintained scraped-surface heat exchanger suffering from shaft eccentricity (>0.8 mm runout), fatigued blade springs causing resonant blade chattering, micro-chipped polymer blades contaminating product, and delaminating chrome plating causing catastrophic metal flake release.

fluidProductProfiles.name: Aseptic Infant Formula & High-Protein Dairy Suspension (Whey/Casein 60:40, TS 28%)
fluidProductProfiles.description: High-solids infant nutrition formulation rich in thermolabile whey proteins (beta-lactoglobulin, alpha-lactalbumin). Extremely prone to rapid burn-on fouling above 75°C, where protein unfolding and thiol-disulfide exchange produce dense insoluble polymer crusts on heat transfer walls.

fluidProductProfiles.name: Commercial Viscous Tomato Paste (30° Brix Hot-Break, High Pectin Yield Stress)
fluidProductProfiles.description: Non-Newtonian pseudoplastic tomato puree with high yield stress (tau_0 = 45 Pa) and insoluble fibrous pulp. Exhibits intense shear-thinning and high boundary layer friction, creating substantial hydrodynamic lift that pushes scraper blades away from the cylinder wall.

fluidProductProfiles.name: Aseptic Cheese Sauce & Starch-Thickened Emulsion (Lipid/Casein/Modified Starch)
fluidProductProfiles.description: High-viscosity culinary sauce containing gelatinized modified waxy maize starch and emulsified cheddar cheese solids. Subject to thermal retrogradation and caramelized starch crusting (Biot number > 0.15) if blade wiping frequency drops below 12 scrapes/sec.

fluidProductProfiles.name: Confectionery Cocoa Butter & Vegetable Fat Blend (Crystallizing Emulsion)
fluidProductProfiles.description: Tempering fat matrix undergoing continuous crystallizing phase transformation. Low thermal conductivity and rapid crystal nucleation on cold cylinder walls require vigorous blade scraping to prevent hardened crystal cake buildup.

bladeMaterials.name: Virgin Polyetheretherketone (PEEK 450G, Food Grade FDA 21 CFR § 177.2415)
bladeMaterials.description: High-performance semicrystalline thermoplastic offering exceptional dimensional stability, high fatigue strength, and low friction against chrome-plated nickel liners. Does not chip or micro-shave under normal hydrodynamic operation.

bladeMaterials.name: Food-Grade Aliphatic Polyketone (PK, 3-A Sanitary / EU 10/2011 Compliant)
bladeMaterials.chemicalResistance: Good (Resistant to weak acids and standard caustic CIP)
bladeMaterials.description: Ductile, wear-resistant engineering polymer featuring superior impact toughness and resilience against thermal cycling. Lower maximum continuous temperature than PEEK.

bladeMaterials.name: Carbon-Graphite Filled PTFE (25% Carbon / 75% Fluoropolymer)
bladeMaterials.description: Ultra-low friction self-lubricating composite material. Highly compliant to cylinder wall ovality, but lower mechanical stiffness makes it vulnerable to hydrodynamic blade flutter and creep deformation at high speeds.

bladeMaterials.name: 17-4PH Precipitation-Hardened Stainless Steel (H900 Condition, 44 HRC)
bladeMaterials.chemicalResistance: Moderate (Sensitive to pitting in high-chloride acidic foods)
bladeMaterials.description: Rigid metal scraper blade for heavy crystalline or frozen crust removal. Must be paired strictly with hard-faced cylinder liners (e.g. chrome plating >60 HRC or Stellite) to avoid catastrophic adhesive galling and gouging.
